scope: Same-identity fictional packaged native checkpoint. It records only the listed executed interactions and closes no aggregate catalogue scenario.

verifiedSlices.name: Remote-content permission
verifiedSlices.result: No controlled HTTP or TLS contact occurred before consent or after permission reset. The reset check intentionally opened UID 2 and restored it to unread before the post-reset receipt. Explicit consent produced five HTTP requests and four expected TLS contact attempts, with no unexpected contact.

verifiedSlices.name: Reader, translation and flags
verifiedSlices.result: Corrected history states 09 through 13 were visually captured. UID 4 local translation made zero controlled network contacts and restored its original Estonian content after translation to English. External star and unstar converged in Smart views; four receipts preserve read-neutral prefetch and background behavior.

verifiedSlices.name: Provider watcher and native attachments
verifiedSlices.result: The production watcher published UID 5 through raw fetch, MIME cache/reopen and Reader attachment presentation. The Reader showed 32 B text and a 28 B unsafe attachment warning. Visible EACCES and real ENOSPC failures left no partial file, then restored and retried safely; collision partial bulk save reported one of two files, a later positive bulk save wrote two exact files with quarantine and non-executable mode, and the leaf-symlink canary remained outside the save target.

verifiedSlices.name: Account and bridge boundaries
verifiedSlices.result: The packaged ACL probe rejected unauthorized command routes. Eleven mailto cases remained unsent, detached reply/reply-all/forward retained the intended account, ten account A/B cycles completed, held-sync Reader and Compose states remained usable, and the bundled CLI shared-profile check passed.

limitations: The mapped WebKit/XPC cohort is unavailable, not zero.
This was the first compatible baseline, so it makes no 20 percent regression claim.

failures.name: Terminal send recovery wording and sidebar accessibility
failures.result: The terminal sent-copy-failed state rendered correctly, keyboard repetition stayed suppressed, and the Needs attention entry reopened an account-locked view-only draft with Send disabled. Two presentation defects remain: the alert conditionally permits resending when the Sent copy is missing, even though that absence is expected after this failure; the Outbox sidebar announces the terminal recovery item as one email sending. The private wording and accessibility fixes are outside this source checkpoint.
failures.nextStep: Apply and validate the combined unconditional no-resend warning and truthful sidebar-label fix; finish same-profile restart and wire/cache watermark acceptance separately.

excludedAutomationIncident.result: A stale accessibility index after history controls renumbered saved three fictional safe attachments. Frames 06 through 08 are excluded; the archived intent and cleanup evidence are retained.

notExecutedOrNotAccepted: Same-profile restart did not launch because its helper refused a wrong-build unsigned path.
The planned UID 7 leap-second replay did not run.
The final schema-v2 upgrade, corrupt-profile alert, notification delivery, physical sleep/wake, a complete WebKit resource cohort and release acceptance did not run.
This checkpoint does not establish all native interactions, provider compatibility, package signing or release readiness.
